discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 8b3f250c0: both configs are committed fixtures under test/smoke/fixtures/configs now and the test no longer writes there, so a smoke run leaves the checkout clean.

Fixed. The test now snapshots and clears `SIGTERM`, `SIGINT` and `beforeExit` listeners before creating its registry, then removes the registry's listeners and restores the originals for all three in `finally`. The new `doEvalSigterm.test.ts` does the same in `beforeEach`/`afterEach`.
Fixed in 88d648f: the test now records the cache setting in beforeEach and restores it in afterEach, the same pattern as chat-cancellation.test.ts. The branch is also up to date with main.

Addressed in the current test suite: it now uses `vi.resetAllMocks()` in `beforeEach`, restores the cache in `afterEach`, and explicitly resets the transport and timing mocks before each case. The affected provider suites pass with randomized Vitest ordering.

Verified against ca9136b. The shared test harness uses isolated fork workers, selects an in-memory database through IS_TESTING, and resets the schema and closes registered database clients in its per-file afterAll. The cases here run sequentially and delete their own evaluations. A one-worker run with the full Eval model suite preceding this MCP suite passed 335 tests across 17 files (one existing skip), including the empty-list assertion. The existing harness already provides the required isolation; an additional database reset is unnecessary.
